The '''VLD2261 long-range heavy blaster defense battery''' was a type of emplaced defensive weapons used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWCL" />

Several of them were built into the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]], where they were manned by [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]].<ref name="SWCL" />
